messages:
Leah (AE): quick heads up — Orchid (retail buyer) wants a 7-day POC. Main asks: can we serve an open 7B chat model with an int8/quantized variant from our catalog, what's the pricing delta for Dedicated vs Hosted, and can we answer their security questionnaire by Monday?
Mohammed (SE): we do have lyra-7b-chat in catalog; theresupported on Triton path with int8 quant. Hosted works out of the box; Dedicated gets better unit economics but needs a reserved pool. I can run a compatibility check tonight.
Ben (ML Eng): note on model behaviour: lyra-7b-chat shows stable kv-cache behavior up to 2k contexts. If they plan long context, suggest quantized-v2 variant (less memory pressure). I can run a smoke perf test against g5.2x.
Anna (Security): their questionnaire asks for ISO27001, SOC2, data residency controls, and KMS/HSM details. We have SOC2 Type II (link to report), KMS integrations documented, and EU regions for residency. ISO27001 we don't have company-wide; Private/on-prem is an option but timeline is 4-6 weeks.
Kai (Solutions): POC path recommendation: start hosted (non-prod) to validate quality/latency -> if ok move to Dedicated for predictable latency and cost. I'll draft an onboarding checklist and a short answers doc for their questionnaire.
Leah (AE): perfect. They prefer hosted first. Need: short FAQ for their security team, a pricing snapshot for a 3-month 100k tokens/day commit, and the model-compat results. Can we get everything before Monday EOD?
Mohammed (SE): I'll run the model-compat scanner now:
```
ri model verify --model lyra-7b-chat --variant quantized-v2 --checks tokenizer,kv_layout,perf-smoke
```
I'll paste the scan output here when done.
Ben (ML Eng): did a quick smoke earlier — p50 42ms, p95 88ms @ 8 tokens/req on g5.2x for quantized-v2. Output similarity to baseline: 99.2% token match on our eval set (short prompts). I'll add a short perf table and notes on memory.
Anna (Security): drafting answers. Quick Q for SEs: do we have any dataflow diagrams for hosted POC (ingress/egress, logs retention) that I can attach?
Mohammed (SE): yes — I'll export the minimal hosted dataflow and retention policy. Will include sample config showing no persistent KV retention across sessions.
Kai (Solutions): pricing draft for Leah: Hosted (gen): $0.0009/token, commit 25% => $0.000675/token; Embeddings separate. For Dedicated: baseline reserved monthly fee ~ $32,000 + usage delta ~ $0.00045/token equivalent (depends on size of pool). I'll put this in a short table.
Leah (AE): great. If SE/ML can post the model-compat output and perf table by tomorrow morning, I'll assemble the POC packet and send to the buyer. Thanks all. :pray:
Mohammed (SE): posted scanner results (summary): tokenizer OK, kv_layout compatible, perf-smoke passed. No immediate blockers. Full logs attached in the ticket.
Ben (ML Eng): uploaded perf table and short notes about tail latency under bursty QPS. Recommendation: cap request size to 64 tokens for stable p95.
Anna (Security): uploaded questionnaire answers + SOC2 link + dataflow diagram. flagged the ISO27001 question as "workaround: Private deployment or third-party attestation conversation".
Leah (AE): sending POC packet to buyer now. Will follow up if they push for Dedicated right away. Thanks team :thumbsup:
